description: The Typing of the Dead (2001 PC port, via Proton and gamescope)
long: The Typing of the Dead is a typing-trainer reimagining of the on-rails light-gun shooter The House of the Dead 2. Instead of aiming a gun, players defeat oncoming zombies by typing words and phrases that appear on screen. It was developed by Sega's Smilebit team and published by Sega.
name: The Typing of the Dead
